business_summary: Xinjiang Yilite Industry Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of liquor in China. The company sells its wines under the Yiliwang Wine, Yili No. 1 Cellar, 52 Degree Yili No.1 Cellar, 52 degrees Yili No. 1 Cellar, Yili Kaiyun T01, Yili Fengtan, Yili Fengtan Collection, Yili Laojiano, Yili Laojiao Great Xinjiang, Yili old wine, Yilit Song, Yilit music, Yilirouya, Elite Navigator, Yili Daqu, Yili Laojiano Collection Edition, Yili General Liquor, Yili impression, Elite Greater Xinjiang, and Yili Daqu Greater Xinjiang liquor brand names. It is also involved in paper product printing; hotel industry; production and sale of glass products; and management and operation of tourist attractions. The company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Kokdala, China.

Laojiano Collection Edition, Yili General Liquor, Yili Impression, Elite Greater Xinjiang 및 Yili Daqu Greater Xinjiang 주류 브랜드 이름입니다. 또한 종이 제품 인쇄에도 관여합니다. 호텔 산업; 유리 제품의 생산 및 판매; 관광명소의 관리 및 운영 등을 담당하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 1956년에 설립되었으며 중국 코크달라에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
